title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1675: Carnage unleashed (3)

section.p: Great Yuan trembled violently while Great Yuan King’s laughter spread everywhere.
“Su Yu, if humanity survives this, your position as the leader will be solidified. If humanity fails to survive this, you will be nothing but a piece of trash! Hahahaha!”
A second explosion followed as all three Invincibles died together. Even more crimson clouds covered the sky while the rain of blood grew heavier.
Great Yuan King, dead.
With his greatly injured body, he had killed three enemy Invincibles.
No, that was not all. The spear he had unleashed with all his strength stabbed through an Invincible behind Su Yu before the Invincible could react.
The said Invincible instantly lost a body. When the second body emerged, the spear exploded, killing the second body. And when the third body emerged, Su Yu’s blade arrived to turn it into micemeat.
The two remaining Invincibles paled as Su Yu roared, activated his Myriad Door Formation, mustered the strength of his crown, and threw a punch out while waves of death qi billowed out of his body.
That one punch blew the two apart.
They could keep him tangled when there were three of them. But with only two of them, they were no match for him.
This was a result of Great Yuan King’s sacrifice.
“Me? A piece of trash?”
Su Yu roared.
Who was Great Yuan King to call him a piece of trash?
Who was Great Yuan King to judge him?
Boom!

In his fury, Su Yu attacked madly. His furious attacks shattered all space around him. The sky itself changed color from his onslaught. After losing two bodies in a row, the two Invincibles self-detonated.

The explosion sent Su Yu flying away. His body was reduced to a mess of broken bones. All his flesh had been reduced to nothingness by the explosion. After some time, he finally rose into the sky again, dragging his badly injured body as he flew toward Zhu Tiandao’s group.
All his opponents were dead.
All of Great Yuan King’s opponents were dead as well. Alas, Great Yuan King himself had also perished.
Great Yuan King. The fourth human Invincible to die today.
Someone hostile toward Su Yu.
But he had ultimately sacrificed himself to help kill Su Yu’s opponents. All for humanity.
As of this moment, Su Yu did not have the luxury to think about anything else. He only had one thought in his mind: to kill. To kill all these bastards.
All the enemy Invincibles in the Human Realm must die.
A total of twenty-six had appeared.
Ten remained.
Great Yuan King and Great Zheng King had perished.
Far away.
The enemy Invincibles fighting Zhu Tiandao’s group paled.
Five more had died!
Today, Invincibles were dying like bugs.
“Ignore him! Kill these people first! Su Yu is so badly injured that he’s as good as a cripple! He can’t do much to us!”
They started shouting among themselves. They only needed to kill these people before Su Yu’s arrival. Su Yu couldn’t change anything alone. Humanity would still lose!

Right at that moment, both Zhou Potian and Yun Chen were blasted out of their fused state, each splitting into three bodies. Su Yu still needed some time to arrive, but they couldn’t hold on for much longer.
Noticing that the two old Invincibles were on the verge of self-detonation, Yun Chen laughed and said, “Su Yu is coming. Nobody else will die. Don’t detonate your—”
A massive explosion erupted!

Both Yun Chen and Zhou Potian were the ones to detonate two of their bodies each. The surrounding enemy Invincibles were hit by the sudden explosions. All of them coughed blood from the newly inflicted injuries.

At almost the same time, Niu Baidao detonated one of his bodies as well. With a rumble, an enemy Invincible lost his second body. With this, all of them had turned into singles. Even with such a high sacrifice, the situation still didn’t improve much for them.
Suddenly, a massive bamboo appeared in the sky.
“Hehe, my chance is here…”
The enemy Invincible, who had just lost a body, was blasted apart.
More crimson clouds covered the sky.

Up in the air, September was casually strolling out of thin air. At the same time, Hu Xiansheng was sighing in Nanyuan. His newly rebuilt teleportation door had exploded right after teleporting September over.
Yes. September.
Almost everyone had forgotten that he was here as well. He had been maintaining a surprisingly low profile after arriving at the Human Realm.

Even when battles were erupting everywhere, he was silently eating to the side. When Su Yu took all the myriad race guests into the Mark of Civilization, September had been left out. After all, the iron devourers had helped him once. He saw no reason to take September into his book as well.

In fact, he had hoped that September would help protect the people at Nanyuan. Thus, September had caught the perfect opportunity to arrive and kill an Invincible. After killing the first Invincible, the massive bamboo swept toward a second Invincible.

The seriously injured Invincible instantly lost a body. His remaining two bodies hurriedly fused into one, but he still wasn’t September’s match. As for Qin Zhen and the others, they started attacking the other Invincibles to create more openings for September to attack.
He was no Invincible, but he was incredibly strong. He started swinging his bamboo everywhere.
A River of Time snapped as the second Invincible lost his second body. When his third body emerged, September descended from the sky and sat on him, crushing his third body.
The River of Time fell apart completely.
Just like that, two Invincibles died.

After killing his second Invincible, September’s body enlarged, blocking in front of Zhu Tiandao and the others. He took on the attacks of the remaining enemy Invincibles with his body, protecting Zhu Tiandao and the others from them. The numerous attacks caused him to cough blood repeatedly, but he appeared completely nonchalant about it.
In fact, he was grinning as he said, “Come on! Hit me! If you can’t kill me, it will be your turn to die soon!”

The enemy Invincibles were greatly shocked. Was he really not an Invincible? His body was a tad bit too terrifying. Even as he was pushed back repeatedly, September still stood in front of the humans. The humans were already greatly weakened. They wouldn’t be able to survive these attacks.

He was different as his body was terrifyingly powerful. However, that was all he could do. He had exhausted most of his strength killing the two Invincibles right after arriving. For now, he could only serve as a shield.
Further away.
With a roar, Junior Zhou King wrapped his River of Time around a fleeing Invincible. Beside him, Heavenly Forge King tossed a body over with a pitiful expression before detonating that body.
He had detonated all his heaven weapons long ago. Thus, he was left with his own bodies to detonate. For now, they could only prioritize killing these people.

At the same time, Junior Zhou King was also tossing character after character forward before detonating them. After a short moment, the bound enemy Invincible started crumbling apart. With his last breath, he roared and detonated himself.
Yet another self-detonation.
Such was a war between races.
In such a war, each battle could be a desperate battle to the death.

Both Heavenly Forge King and Junior Zhou King were sent flying by the explosion. As the dead enemy was stronger than them, it took them quite a while to recover and walk out of the pile of dirt they were buried in. With a sigh, Heavenly Forge King asked, “I’m left with one body. How about you?”
“One.” Junior Zhou King remained expressionless.
With the same pitiful expression, Heavenly Forge King lamented, “Well done. All the survivors have been reduced to being singles. Well done, myriad races.”
They were all singles now. That included Su Yu, who had never trained a tri-life body before. This applied to all the Invincibles and Pseudo Invincibles in the Human Realm.
Well, this wasn’t too bad.
Since everyone was single, nobody could laugh at the other for being a single, right?
Junior Zhou King said nothing else. The two hurriedly flew elsewhere to help with the battle that had yet to end.
All these enemies must die.
Damn these bastards!
So what if they were singles?
They were still alive. That was enough.

While flying, Heavenly Forge King said, “By the way, do you think those nine-leaf skylotus petals of Su Yu are real? If they are real, there is still hope for us to recover. Otherwise…well, he’s quite rich in carrier treasures. He probably wouldn’t mind giving us some, right? We’re too poor to buy his carrier treasures so if he refuses to gift them to us, I suppose we’ll have to start a singles club or something like that.”
“Enough talking.”

Junior Zhou King was annoyed. Did the geezer go mad after becoming a single? Then again, the geezer was right. This war had created quite a lot of single guys. He wondered how the people in the Celestial Chasm Realm were doing.
If they all returned as singles as well…good heavens. Just imagine it. All human Invincibles as singles. What a sight to behold.
A short while later.
Su Yu arrived.

He came bearing a boundless killing intent. Noticing his arrival, the five enemy Invincibles wanted to flee, but September was keeping them too occupied to actually flee. Additionally, the now-single humans were also madly attacking to prevent them from escaping.

Right after arriving, Su Yu attacked like a mad fiend. His Mark of Civilization dropped down from the sky while his crown emanated a powerful pressure to suppress them. Meanwhile, Jade King and the other immortal king had lost all their previous calm. Rather, they were attacking the female furball desperately to create an opportunity to flee.
Fuck!
The humans had gone mad! When they first arrived, things were looking quite good for them. But in the blink of an eye, humanity had reversed the situation by using their tri-life bodies as bombs.
Naturally, the furious female furball wouldn’t allow them to flee.
Why flee?
She was angry!

She had encountered so many annoying bastards today! She decided to wait until Su Yu was done over there before getting his help with these two. She swore to eat these annoying bastards. How dare they annoy her so?
Shortly after, Junior Zhou King and Heavenly Forge King arrived as well. Together, they surrounded and bombarded the five enemy Invincibles.

One of them self-detonated, blasting an arm of Su Yu apart. Next, a second Invincible self-detonated, blasting a leg of Su Yu apart. The other three wanted to self-detonate as well, but Su Yu’s mouth suddenly enlarged before biting down. All his teeth broke apart, but one of them was bitten into two.
Then, he slammed his head forward.
With his head that had been tempered in the Luminous Domain Mansion, he smashed another Invincible apart. He was fighting like a wild beast.
Next, he wrapped his sole remaining arm around another Invincible before crushing that Invincible. Desperate, that Invincible self-detonated and blasted his sole remaining arm apart.
With both arms gone, Su Yu started attacking with his head.

He was not fighting alone. The others were also fighting. They were fighting in such a brutish manner that it looked more like a street brawl, yet space continued shattering within a radius of a hundred meters.
Up in the sky, numerous crimson clouds appeared. After an indeterminate amount of time, they landed on the ground again. All their enemies had died.
The tired September sat down, using Qin Zhen as a cushion. The tired Qin Zhen coughed a mouthful of blood before complaining, “F-fuck you! F-fuck off! Or..or I’ll die!”

With great difficulty, September crawled off. Then, he turned around and patted Qin Zhen’s head with his gigantic paw. He looked rather apologetic at having nearly crushed an Invincible to death by sitting on that Invincible.

Then, all of them turned to look at Su Yu, who had been reduced to a human stick. He had lost all four of his limbs to the self-detonations of their enemies. In fact, he had lost so much blood that he wasn’t even bleeding anymore. If it wasn’t for the fact that his head was still moving, they would have thought that he was dead.
While gasping for breath, Su Yu asked, “Two more. Who…can still fight?”

It would be quite hard for the female furball to kill Jade King and the other immortal king alone. That much was obvious from how long the battle had lasted. As he spoke, he released a large amount of solidwater pearls like they were free. He also took out numerous dragonblood fruits before feasting upon them.

That was not all. He even crushed a small dragonblood fruit tree to replenish everyone with a large amount of life force. Not satisfied with the speed, he soon crushed the bigger dragonblood fruit tree as well. This was not the time to care about wastage.
Eat.
Absorb.
And recover.
They still needed to kill the two immortal kings after recovering. Thus, everyone started feasting on the treasures to recover and replenish their energy.

Su Yu was taking out his treasures like they were free. After all, their injuries were too heavy yet they couldn’t afford to take their time with recovery. At this point, all twenty-four of the hidden enemy Invincibles had died. Only the two immortal kings, who had sneaked into the Human Realm after the start of the battle, remained. With two Invincibles and numerous tri-life bodies as the price, humanity had eliminated twenty-four enemy Invincibles.
By the time all the treasures were devoured, Su Yu had regrown all his limbs. He still looked weak, but he roared loudly, “Let’s go. There are more people to kill!”
With that, they set off.
To kill more people.
Today, they had sustained heavy injuries. But they also felt great.
They had killed a large number of Invincibles.

They had never experienced such freedom, not even during the war four hundred years ago. As such, even the old Invincibles were looking as excited as a boy with a toy. As far as they were concerned, this was how a war should be fought.
Kill. Kill until the very sky changed colors.
Kill until nobody dared to covet the Human Realm anymore.
Far away.
Jade King’s expression changed slightly when he noticed the approaching group. With a rumble, his second and third bodies exploded while he shot off as a red beam of light in his sole remaining body.
With a flicker, he vanished into nothingness.
The other immortal king paled upon realizing that he had been left behind.
“Jade King—”
“Nom!”

With a bite, the female furball crunched the immortal king in her mouth before swallowing him. Just as she was about to give chase, the immortal king exploded inside her body, sending her flying around like a leaking balloon yet again.
Up above, the sky split open.
Jade King could be seen flying through the crack without any hesitation.
He had escaped.

Of the twenty-six Invincibles who had appeared, he was the sole survivor. Even so, he had survived with only one body. He knew that everything was over the moment Su Yu’s group started approaching. Thus, he detonated his two bodies before using the other immortal king as a shield to escape the female furball.

By the time Su Yu’s group arrived, the female furball had recovered from the explosions inside her body. She looked incredibly furious and gloomy. She was very angry! Alas, the target of her wrath had escaped.
With that, the battle in the Human Realm ended. Twenty-five Invincibles and two of Jade King’s bodies had perished in this battle.

It was worth noting that Jade King had just lost a body not long ago. He had recovered after receiving a valuable treasure from the immortal race. Barely two months had passed since then, yet he had lost two bodies this time. He was an ancient fossil who was also a ninth-degree Eternal. He had acted only two times after his awakening. Yet he had suffered massively both times.
Su Yu sneered and said, “I will not allow this to happen a third time. The next time I meet him, he will die!”
The female furball was fuming, but she said nothing. Her injuries were quite heavy as well. Thus, she returned to the Mark of Civilization and resumed sulking in the book instead. She was very angry.

Noticing her anger, Su Yu poked the little furball and told the little fellow to comfort his mama. Why was the unfilial little fellow watching without doing anything when his mama was in such a bad mood?

With a grumble, the little furball flew into the Mark of Civilization as well. What could he even do? He knew that his mama was sulking because she was embarrassed at failing to eat Jade King. His mama would be fine if she were fed with Jade King. How simple.
Su Yu retracted his focus from his sea of willpower and looked around. Moments later, he cursed. How were they supposed to keep fighting? Just look at all the single guys around him.
A massive battle was still raging outside the Human Realm. When an Invincible was reduced into a single, the Invincible would be greatly weakened. And a whole bunch of them had turned into singles.
How were they supposed to counterattack in such a state?
